samples.question: Rotate the single framed mosaic until the cyan corner is upper left and the gold corner is upper right. In each of its ten rows of nine cells, compare every side-by-side neighboring pair from left to right. Make an eight-cell result row: dark exactly when the two compared cells differ, and light when they match. Stack the ten result rows without reordering. Which symbol needs the fewest cell changes to match the 10 by 8 result: diamond, fork, or stair? A tie is ambiguous.
